messages.subject: Project Vertex - disclosure points to nail down
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Sarah,

From the data-room review, three things need to land in the Disclosure Letter and warranty schedule: (1) the Meridian Diagnostics research licence over the companion-diagnostic family; (2) the April 2024 Pemberton Rowe enquiry on the combination patent - I think we want a specific indemnity there; and (3) the late US renewal on CBX-VTX-009. None are deal-breakers but all need flagging.

Tom

messages.plaintextBody:
Good. Agree on the indemnity for the Pemberton Rowe point - draft it into clause 6. Make sure the Meridian licence is carved out of the exclusivity grant, not just disclosed. Let's get a draft Disclosure Letter to Hargrove with v3.

James
